Like AutoMechanic said above, 1st find someone locally if you can; they still exist. After that, get a new one and not rebuilt from a known good manufacturer. I buy parts from reputable suppliers and rebuild them myself as I got tired of replacing the Auto Parts stores ones every few years under warranty.
